degree_rationale: Why ancient generations had longer lifespans — the five way-leaders (year, month, day, hour, moment) reigning successively, with offspring's life-measure shrinking accordingly. Treats the inner mechanism of generational diminution.
direction_rationale: Reflective inward processing of why-lifespans-have-shrunk — the lord-of-year, lord-of-month etc. as inward keys. Reception-into-understanding of the diminution-mechanism.
grand_man_function: Spiritual generational reception — how lifespans receive their measure from temporal lords.
title: Why the lifespan of the first generations was so much greater than ours
